consciousness.en: The lecture examined how sleep can affect human consciousness and attention.
consciousness.zh: 這場演講探討睡眠如何影響人的意識與注意力。

consolidate.en: The team decided to consolidate several notes into one clear report.
consolidate.zh: 團隊決定把數份筆記整合成一份清楚報告。

constable.en: A village constable helped direct traffic during the local festival.
constable.zh: 一名村鎮警員在地方慶典期間協助指揮交通。

contented.en: She felt contented after completing the project ahead of schedule.
contented.zh: 她提前完成專題後感到滿足。

contingent.en: The outdoor event is contingent on suitable weather conditions.
contingent.zh: 戶外活動是否舉行取決於合適的天候。

continuation.en: The second chapter is a continuation of the story introduced earlier.
continuation.zh: 第二章延續了前面開始的故事。

convertible.en: The museum displayed a classic convertible from the early twentieth century.
convertible.zh: 博物館展示了一輛二十世紀早期的經典敞篷車。

convincing.en: Her explanation was convincing because it included clear evidence.
convincing.zh: 她的解釋因為包含清楚證據而很有說服力。

coordination.en: Good coordination helped the group finish the event on time.
coordination.zh: 良好的協調讓團隊準時完成活動。

copilot.en: The copilot reviewed the flight plan before departure.
copilot.zh: 副駕駛在起飛前檢查了飛行計畫。

cosmic.en: The documentary explored cosmic events occurring far beyond our solar system.
cosmic.zh: 紀錄片探討發生在太陽系之外的宇宙事件。

cosmopolitan.en: The port developed into a cosmopolitan city with many cultures.
cosmopolitan.zh: 這座港口發展成擁有多元文化的國際城市。

cosy.en: The small reading room felt cosy on the rainy afternoon.
cosy.zh: 下雨的午後，這間小閱覽室顯得十分舒適。

councilman.en: The councilman attended a public meeting about neighborhood transportation.
councilman.zh: 那位市議員參加了一場關於社區交通的公開會議。

counseling.en: The school offers counseling for students who need academic support.
counseling.zh: 學校為需要課業支持的學生提供輔導。

counsellor.en: A school counsellor helped students plan their course selections.
counsellor.zh: 學校輔導員協助學生規劃選課。

countenance.en: His calm countenance reassured the group before the presentation.
countenance.zh: 他平靜的神情讓大家在報告前安心不少。

countless.en: The library contains countless stories from many countries and periods.
countless.zh: 圖書館收藏了來自不同國家與時代的無數故事。

cowardice.en: The novel questions whether silence should always be called cowardice.
cowardice.zh: 這本小說探討沉默是否總該被稱為懦弱。

coworker.en: Her coworker shared useful notes from the morning meeting.
coworker.zh: 她的同事分享了早上會議的實用筆記。

creditable.en: The student produced a creditable report despite limited preparation time.
creditable.zh: 儘管準備時間有限，那名學生仍完成了一份值得肯定的報告。

creed.en: The article compares the creed of several historical movements.
creed.zh: 文章比較了幾個歷史運動的信念。

crossroad.en: A small sign stood beside the crossroad outside the village.
crossroad.zh: 村外的十字路口旁立著一面小標誌。

crouch.en: The photographer had to crouch to capture the flower from below.
crouch.zh: 攝影師必須蹲下才能從低角度拍到那朵花。

crowded.en: The station became crowded shortly before the evening train arrived.
crowded.zh: 晚間列車抵達前不久，車站變得很擁擠。

crumble.en: Old bricks may crumble after years of exposure to harsh weather.
crumble.zh: 老磚塊經過多年風吹雨打後可能會碎裂。

cubic.en: The math problem asks for the volume in cubic centimeters.
cubic.zh: 這道數學題要求以立方公分計算體積。

culminate.en: Months of practice will culminate in a final concert this Friday.
culminate.zh: 數月練習將在本週五的最終音樂會達到高潮。

cylinder.en: The science kit includes a clear cylinder for measuring liquid volume.
cylinder.zh: 科學實驗組包含一個用來量液體體積的透明量筒。

dame.en: The biography describes how the actress later became a dame.
dame.zh: 這本傳記描述那位女演員後來獲授女爵士頭銜。

daresay.en: I daresay the second plan will be easier to complete.
daresay.zh: 我想第二個方案應該會更容易完成。

diffusion.en: The experiment demonstrated diffusion as color spread through the water.
diffusion.zh: 實驗藉由顏色在水中擴散來展示擴散現象。

dignify.en: A respectful explanation can dignify even a difficult disagreement.
dignify.zh: 尊重的說明方式能讓困難的爭議更有尊嚴地進行。

dignitary.en: A visiting dignitary opened the cultural exhibition with a short speech.
dignitary.zh: 一位來訪貴賓以簡短致詞為文化展揭幕。

disapproval.en: The committee expressed disapproval of the poorly documented proposal.
disapproval.zh: 委員會對缺乏完整資料的提案表示不贊同。

disbelieve.en: At first, some readers may disbelieve the surprising result.
disbelieve.zh: 一開始，有些讀者可能不相信這個令人驚訝的結果。

disco.en: The museum exhibit included music and fashion from the disco era.
disco.zh: 博物館展覽收錄了迪斯可年代的音樂與時尚。

discontent.en: Growing discontent led residents to request another public meeting.
discontent.zh: 日益增加的不滿促使居民要求再開一次公開會議。

discouraging.en: The first test result was discouraging, but the team kept improving.
discouraging.zh: 第一次測試結果令人洩氣，但團隊仍持續改進。

discrepancy.en: The auditor noticed a discrepancy between the two financial records.
discrepancy.zh: 稽核人員注意到兩份財務紀錄之間有差異。

discretion.en: The teacher used discretion when discussing a student's private concern.
discretion.zh: 老師在討論學生的私人困擾時保持謹慎。

disgusting.en: The spoiled food had a disgusting smell, so it was discarded.
disgusting.zh: 變質食物有令人作嘔的氣味，因此被丟棄。

dishwasher.en: The restaurant installed a new dishwasher in the kitchen last month.
dishwasher.zh: 餐廳上個月在廚房裝了一台新的洗碗機。

disinterested.en: A disinterested judge should evaluate each entry by the same standards.
disinterested.zh: 公正無私的評審應以相同標準評量每件作品。

dismantle.en: Workers will dismantle the temporary stage after the festival ends.
dismantle.zh: 慶典結束後，工作人員會拆除臨時舞台。

disorganized.en: The notes looked disorganized until she sorted them by topic.
disorganized.zh: 那些筆記原本很凌亂，直到她依主題整理。

dispel.en: Clear evidence can dispel confusion about how the process works.
dispel.zh: 清楚證據可以消除大家對流程運作方式的疑惑。

displacement.en: The lesson explained displacement using distance and direction on a map.
displacement.zh: 課堂用地圖上的距離和方向說明位移。

displease.en: The sudden schedule change may displease some participants.
displease.zh: 突然更改時程可能讓部分參與者不滿。

disposition.en: Her calm disposition helped the group handle unexpected problems.
disposition.zh: 她沉著的性情幫助團隊處理突發問題。
